item.title: Olympic bobsledder and mom of boys with special needs wins first gold
item.description: Elana Meyers Taylor, who just won her first gold medal, is tied with speedskater Bonnie Blair for the most medals won by a female U.S. Winter Olympian.

item.title: Pro-life advocates hold rally after baby left to die following failed abortion
item.description: “Last night thousands rallied in Brisbane in memory of baby Samuel,” South Australian pro-life advocate Joanna Howe posted on social media.

item.title: 21 states join Louisiana's lawsuit challenging the FDA's abortion pill changes
item.description: The states contend that the 2023 REMS change was an "infringement on state sovereignty" by allowing some states to "superimpose their views" on others.

item.title: Abortion trainees still use various types of produce to learn how to kill
item.description: Colleges and universities continue to use dragon fruit, papayas, and other produce to train medical students in how to commit abortions.

item.title: Jesse Jackson, who once defended the rights of preborn humans, has died
item.description: Jackson became heavily involved in the civil rights movement and was an ardent pro-life activist until a presidential run in 1984.

item.title: 60 lawmakers file brief supporting Louisiana's FDA abortion pill challenge
item.description: Sixty lawmakers have filed an amicus brief in support of the State of Louisiana's challenge to the FDA's eroding safety regulations for the abortion pill.

item.title: Preborn baby found in South Carolina water treatment plant
item.description: An autopsy was carried out, and as is required by law, a tissue sample was taken for a DNA test, which is also required when an unidentified body is found.

item.title: Baby found in portable toilet tank was born alive... and drowned
item.description: It is believed that the woman gave birth to a living baby, cut the umbilical cord, and put the child in the holding tank, where she drowned.

item.title: Alaska House bill would let pharmacists prescribe and distribute abortion pills
item.description: The bill is opposed by the Alaska Medical Board, which warns that pharmacists should not be granted the ability to practice medicine.

item.title: FDA says it plans for abortion pill safety review to be completed in a year 'or sooner'
item.description: In February, the FDA updated its website, claiming it is "conducting a safety study of mifepristone" and that its plan is to have it done in a year or sooner.
